verified_facts.text: Platte Island lies in the Indian Ocean around 130 kilometers south of Mahé and is part of the Seychelles Outer Islands.
verified_facts.excerpt: Situated in the Indian Ocean, around 130 kilometers south of Mahé Island, Platte Island is part of the Seychelles Outer Islands.

verified_facts.text: The private plane flight to the island is charged for a fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our island is accessible exclusively by private plane flight for a fee.

verified_facts.text: Before the flight, an airport concierge escorts guests to the Waldorf Astoria Lounge above the domestic terminal check-in, with WiFi, complimentary drinks and showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Before your scenic flight to Platte Island, our airport concierge will escort you to the lounge, where you can relax with unlimited WiFi, complimentary drinks, and shower facilities.

verified_facts.text: Villas have a large terrace, a private pool and direct beach access from the villa's own garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy spacious accommodations with elegant amenities, a large terrace, and a private pool, alongside direct beach access from your own garden.

verified_facts.text: La Perle offers poolside dining inspired by Northern Mediterranean and Asian cuisines.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience elegant poolside dining inspired by Northern Mediterranean and Asian cuisines.

verified_facts.text: Maison Des Epices serves Creole and Latino cooking, with open-fire cooking and handmade spices.
verified_facts.excerpt: Delight in authentic Creole and Latino traditions, featuring sustainable open-fire cooking and handmade spices.

verified_facts.text: Moulin uses seasonal produce harvested from the restaurant's own garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor exclusive dishes and enjoy seasonal produce harvested directly from the restaurant's own garden.

verified_facts.text: Lalin is a bar with ocean views, an extensive liquor collection and cocktails from sunset.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy breathtaking ocean views, an extensive liquor collection, and inventive cocktails from sunset to starlight.

verified_facts.text: Torti serves light lunches, cool drinks and Asian cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor light lunches, enjoy cool drinks, and experience the vibrant flavors of luxurious Asian cuisine.

verified_facts.text: Peacock Terrace is a modern reflection of the original New York Peacock Terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience a distinctive, modern reflection of the original New York location at Peacock Terrace.

verified_facts.text: The Waldorf Astoria Spa has six treatment suites.
verified_facts.excerpt: With six treatment suites, we provide contemporary and traditional therapies, facial and body treatments, and spa rituals.

verified_facts.text: Activities include snorkeling, diving, guided sunrise wildlife walks, sunset yoga and masterclasses.
verified_facts.excerpt: Recharge and reconnect with endless activities, from snorkeling and diving to guided sunrise wildlife walks, sunset yoga, and exclusive masterclasses.

verified_facts.text: Champagne Rock is the island's natural beach bar, and floating breakfasts can be served in the villa's private pool.

verified_facts.text: Platte Island is a sand cay that was originally an uninhabited coconut plantation.
verified_facts.excerpt: This sand cay was originally an uninhabited coconut plantation

verified_facts.text: All villa buildings are set back from the beach so hawksbill turtles can keep laying eggs undisturbed.
verified_facts.excerpt: All buildings are set back from the beach so that hawksbill turtles can continue laying their eggs undisturbed.

verified_facts.text: The Marine Mavericks Teens Club engages older children in marine conservation and sustainability.
